overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long GOOGL Daily ETF (GOOL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOGL) stock, less fees and expenses GOOL was launched on Jul 2, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.
